newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Samper to announce oil find - source.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Samper to announce oil find - source.

text.p: Colombian President Ernesto Samper is expected to announce a major new oil find at a news conference in New York Wednesday wrapping up his four-day official visit to the United Nations, a source at the state oil company Ecopetrol said.
The source said the annoucement would concern the Coporo field, located about 60 miles (100 km) northeast of Bogota.
Ecopetrol estimated last year that the field had up to 1.3 billion barrels of crude oil, rivaling the nearby Piedemonte and Cusiana fields in Colombia's eastern planes.
The Ecopetrol source said Coporo was wholly owned and operated by Ecopetrol, which has invested $40 million in test wells at the site that now reach a depth of 17,000 feet.
He declined further comment, however, pending Samper's official announcement in New York.
